source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban land" AND (acquisition OR market OR conversion OR speculation)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban land" AND (acquisition OR market OR conversion OR speculation),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban land" AND ("acquisition" OR "conversion" OR "market" OR "speculation"))
